land.text: the undivided Frankish realm of 705-717, of which Neustria was the north-western part

predecessors.note: All 553 cells of Cliopatria's Neustria outline lie inside its Kingdom of the Franks shape for 705-723 (my gazetteer check); the Frankish row loses them only in 724-731 and regains them in 732.

land.text: Neustria after Charles Martel 'defeated Ragenfrid and the rebellious Neustrians' in 724, back inside the Frankish realm

successors.note: Cliopatria draws Neustria separately for 724-731 and the Frankish row without it; the pages do not support that (see keyframes).

rulers.name: Chilperic II
rulers.note: Neustria page king list 715-721; the Francia page has 'In 720 Chilperic II died'. His rule was 'restricted to Neustria' from 717 and the kingdom 'reunited under Chilperic II' in 718. [Reviewer eu-07-c, 2026-10-24: clipped from 715 to the dossier's start (717); the Neustria page lists Chilperic II 715-721.]

rulers.name: Theuderic IV
rulers.title: puppet king of the reunited Frankish realm
rulers.note: 'In 720 Chilperic II died, and Theuderic IV was appointed king, but he was a puppet king' (Francia). The mayors were Ragenfrid 715-718 and Charles Martel 718-741 (Neustria page). [Reviewer eu-07-c, 2026-10-24: clipped from 737 to the dossier's end (724); the Neustria page lists Theuderic IV 721-737.]

correction.text: Neustria as Cliopatria draws it (131 k km2, 2.8 W to 4.9 E, 46.8 to 50.2 N), standing for the realm to which Chilperic II was 'restricted' in 717 and for the rebellious Neustrians of 718-724

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe for 717-724. Cliopatria has no Neustria before 724, but 'In 717 Charles installed Chlothar IV in opposition to King Chilperic II, whose rule was thereby restricted to Neustria. This marked the first time since 679 that the kingdom was divided' (Francia). The land is drawn with Cliopatria's own Neustria outline (131,302 km2; the pages give no boundary and no area). From 718 the land is contested (ledger): 'Following Chlothar's death in 718, the kingdom was reunited under Chilperic II' but Charles went on fighting the Neustrians until 724.

correction.text: the reunited Frankish realm of Theuderic IV and the mayor Charles Martel: Cliopatria's 724 Frankish shape together with the Neustrian land it leaves out

keyframe_review.note: Cliopatria draws a separate Neustria for 724-731 and takes it out of the Kingdom of the Franks for the same years. The pages say the opposite: 'in 724 he defeated Ragenfrid and the rebellious Neustrians, ending the civil war phase of his rule' (Francia), the kingdom was 'reunited under Chilperic II' in 718, Theuderic IV was a 'puppet king' from 720/721, and 'Neustria, Austrasia, and Burgundy then became united under one authority' (Neustria, undated). 724 itself is kept as the last year in the 717 keyframe; for 725-731 the land belongs to the Frankish realm. Nominally Neustria still had a king (Theuderic IV, list 721-737): the pages give no border for it. No area on either page.

ledger.note: 717: Charles Martel sets up Chlothar IV against Chilperic II, 'whose rule was thereby restricted to Neustria': 'the first time since 679 that the kingdom was divided'. The mayor of the palace in Neustria was Ragenfrid (715-718) and the capital Soissons (Neustria page). The page gives the realm's name, not its boundary: Cliopatria's Neustria outline is used.

region.text: the Neustrian land fought over from Soissons (718) to 724

ledger.note: 718: Charles defeats the Neustrian side at Soissons. 'In 718 at the Battle of Soissons, Charles defeated his rivals and forced them into hiding.' After Chlothar IV died the same year 'the kingdom was reunited under Chilperic II' (nominal head), but the Neustrians kept fighting Charles until 724.

724: Charles Martel ends the Neustrian resistance. 'in 724 he defeated Ragenfrid and the rebellious Neustrians, ending the civil war phase of his rule.' The page does not name the place or the land Ragenfrid held; the zone is the Neustria outline.

region.text: Neustria, back inside the Frankish realm

ledger.note: 724: Neustria is absorbed into the Frankish realm. The end year is that of the page's 'ending the civil war phase of his rule'; Neustria, Austrasia and Burgundy 'then became united under one authority' (Neustria page, undated). Cliopatria's own separate Neustria shape for 724-731 is rejected in the keyframes.

wars.name: Charles Martel's civil war against the Neustrians
wars.outcome: Charles installed Chlothar IV in 717 and defeated his rivals at Soissons in 718; the kingdom was reunited under Chilperic II in 718 but Charles Martel only 'defeated Ragenfrid and the rebellious Neustrians' in 724, 'ending the civil war phase of his rule'.
wars.note: Francia page. The Neustria page lists Ragenfrid as mayor 715-718 and Charles Martel from 718. Vinchy (717) is not on either page, so 717's fighting is not dated here.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary of Neustria; the outline is Cliopatria's and approximate throughout. The Neustria page notes that later 'Neustria' meant 'land between the Seine and Loire'.

sources.title: Neustria
sources.note: State article: capital Soissons, king and mayor lists with years, 687 Tertry; thin for 717-731 and gives no area.

sources.title: Francia
sources.note: 717 division, 718 Soissons and reunion, 720 Theuderic IV, 724 Ragenfrid; also used by merovingian-empire. Opened twice (infobox and dated sentences).

notes: Cliopatria's Kingdom of Neustria (724-731, 131 k km2) cannot be reconciled with the pages: no page shows a separate Neustria in those years; the separate kingdom is 717-718 (Francia) and the Neustrian rebellion ends in 724. This dossier therefore lives 717-724 and rejects the 725-731 shape (verdict wrong, land goes to the Frankish realm). The owner of kingdom-of-the-franks should (a) not exclude Neustria from the Frankish shape 724-731 (Cliopatria's 724-731 Frankish shape has none of Neustria's 553 cells) and (b) record Neustria's 717-724 contest from its side. The Neustria page's king list (Theuderic IV 721-737 as king of Neustria) is the case for Cliopatria's reading; it gives no border. Pages not opened (budget): Battle of Vincy, Battle of Soissons (718), Ragenfrid, Chilperic II, Theuderic IV, Charles Martel, which would date 717 (Vinchy) and place Ragenfrid's last stand. Neustria as the Merovingian subkingdom of 511-679 is not in Cliopatria and needs its own dossier (counterparts_needing_dossiers). Gazetteer: no names needed.
